document_type.description: Best-effort document type for the page or document, such as newspaper, report, invoice, form, slide, academic_paper, textbook, book_page, note, or unknown.

language.description: Dominant language of the visible content, using an ISO 639-1 code when possible, such as en, vi, zh, ja, fr, or unknown.

title.description: Main visible title, headline, or document heading. Use an empty string when no title is visible.

main_text.description: Full readable body text in natural reading order. Preserve headings, captions, list items, and important inline values. Do not add explanations that are not visible in the source.

tables.description: Tables visible in the source. Return an empty array when there are no tables.

caption.description: Visible table caption, title, or nearby label. Use an empty string when none is visible.

content.description: Table content as Markdown or compact plain text, preserving rows, columns, and header labels when possible.

figures.description: Figures, charts, diagrams, photographs, or illustrations visible in the source. Return an empty array when there are no figures.

caption.description: Visible figure caption, label, or nearby title. Use an empty string when none is visible.

description.description: Brief factual description of the figure based only on visible content, labels, and captions.

formulas.description: Important mathematical formulas visible in the source. Return an empty array when there are no formulas.

items.description: Formula text, preferably in LaTeX when the formula is mathematical.
